CliAutoHint: Leave empty to find Codex automatically.
LoginHint: Sign in with codex login for subscription limits. Updates happen automatically.
StatusHelp: Updates are automatic. Full rings mean all quota is available; empty rings mean none. Double-click the compact rings to expand.
ResetsDetailsIncomplete: Expiry details are incomplete. This is the earliest date returned by Codex, not a guaranteed earliest expiry across all resets.
ResetPending: Previous reset outcome is unknown. Retry the same attempt.
ResetConfirm: Use one available reset for eligible Codex usage limits? This spends one reset.
RetryConfirm: Retry the previous reset using the same request. If it already succeeded, no second reset will be spent.
NothingToReset: No eligible limits need a reset.
ResetUncertain: Reset could not be confirmed. Retry the same attempt.
PendingStoreError: Pending reset data could not be saved or read. No new reset was sent.
RefreshToReset: Refresh to load available reset details.
ResetTimePassed: Reset time passed · waiting for Codex
AlreadyRunning: The widget is already running. Open it from the Windows system tray.
SettingsSaveError: Could not save settings. Check the Codex path and folder permissions.
CliMissing: Codex CLI not found. Select it in Settings.
Timeout: Codex did not respond in time. We will reconnect automatically.
LoginRequired: Run codex login to access subscription limits.
LimitsUnavailable: Codex has not returned the requested limits.
RequestRejected: Codex rejected the request. Check login and CLI version.
Disconnected: Disconnected. Reconnecting on the next refresh.
ConnectionError: Could not read Codex data. Check connection, login and CLI path.
AlertsInvalid: Use a quota threshold of 1–99% and 1–168 hours.
ExtraInfoHint: Experimental · loads on opening and every 5 minutes while visible.
ActivityHelp: Historical tokens are separate from quota percentages. Dates are reported by the service; a missing day is not zero.
CreditsHelp: Credits and spend allowance are separate from included quota. Only backend-reported permission determines availability.
ThreadHelp: Costs are estimates, not final billing. Context and reasoning data appear only when reported on this connection; other clients may not stream here.
AlertsHelp: Custom app popups use existing quota polling. Each quota window or expiring reset is notified once per app session. Disabled by default.
InstallUpdateHint: Saves settings, installs the verified release and restarts the application.
UpdateIdle: Checks at startup and every 6 hours when automatic updates are enabled.
UpdateCurrent: No newer stable release is available.
UpdateReady: Update verified and ready to install.
UpdateFailed: Could not complete the update. Check connection, release assets and folder permissions, then retry.
UpdateDevelopment: Automatic installation requires a packaged Portable or Lite build. This development copy can check releases.
UpdateInProgress: The application is being updated. It will reopen automatically.
